issues.description: import-notation early-exit false negative when url() appears inside supports()
issues.detail: In `lib/rules/import-notation/index.mjs`, when `primary === 'url'` the regex `/url\(/i.test(params)` bails on the entire params. For `@import "foo" supports(background: url(bar))`, the import target is a string but the regex matches the inner url(), so the rule silently skips a violation that previously would have been reported.

issues.description: selector-not-notation walk filter changes case-sensitivity behavior
issues.detail: The original code used `selector.includes(':not(')` (case-sensitive). The new walkRules filter `/:not\(/i` is case-insensitive, so selectors like `:NOT(.foo)` that were previously skipped now flow into parseSelector. This may be the intended fix, but it is a behavior change not mentioned in the changeset and lacks a test.

issues.description: HAS_NUMERIC regex inconsistently omits the `i` flag
issues.detail: In `font-weight-notation/index.mjs`, `HAS_NAMED` uses the `i` flag but `HAS_NUMERIC` does not. The numeric tokens are digits so the flag is irrelevant for correctness, but the asymmetry is confusing for future maintainers and is worth aligning for consistency with the named-keyword regex.

issues.description: Inline duplicated regex construction instead of shared utility
issues.detail: The PR builds `HAS_NAMED`, `HAS_NUMERIC`, `HAS_PERCENTAGE`, and `HAS_KEYWORD` directly inside rule files from imported keyword sets. Other rules in the codebase keep these in `utils/regexes.mjs` (mayIncludeRegexes). Centralizing avoids duplication and keeps the keyword/regex pairs in lockstep when sets change.

issues.description: keyframe-selector-notation `/./` regex defeats walkRules filter optimization
issues.detail: For `primary === 'percentage-unless-within-keyword-only-block'`, `selectorRegex = /./` means every rule still passes the filter, providing no perf benefit for that mode. Consider building a combined regex of both keywords and percentages, or document why this mode is excluded from the optimization.

issues.description: No tests added for new early-exit branches
issues.detail: The PR is a performance change with subtle behavior implications (case-sensitivity in selector-not, regex semantics in import-notation). The changeset says "performance" but no regression tests were added to confirm that previously-flagged inputs still get flagged after the early-exit. Adding a small test per rule would harden against future regex regressions.

review.summary: The PR adds regex-based early-exit checks to six `*-notation` rules to skip parse work when the input cannot possibly violate the rule. The general approach is sound and consistent with other recent stylelint perf work. The most material concern is `import-notation`, where the broad `/url\(/i.test(params)` check can trip on `url(...)` tokens inside `supports()` and silently skip a real string-import violation. A behavior change in `selector-not-notation` (case-insensitive filter) is also worth calling out. Other items are nits around regex consistency and missing regression coverage.
